llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization (filed with the State Corporation Commission)
llc.formation_notes: Statutory fee $100 (Va. Code § 13.1-1005); same for foreign registration. No publication requirement.

annual_report.name: Annual registration fee (no separate annual report form)
annual_report.due: last day of the anniversary month of formation (each year after the month organized)

sources.title: Va. Code § 13.1-1005. Fees
sources.quote: For filing any one of the following, the fee shall be $100: a. Articles of organization.

sources.title: Va. Code § 13.1-1062. Annual registration fees
sources.quote: on or before the last day of the twelfth month next succeeding the month in which it was organized ... an annual registration fee of $50

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Annual election on a timely filed Form 502; 5.75% on Virginia taxable income of the entity (Va. Code § 58.1-390.3). Text in force on 2026-10-15 has no end date (applies to taxable years beginning on and after 2022-01-01).

sources.title: Va. Code § 58.1-390.3. Elective pass-through entity tax
sources.quote: A tax at the rate of 5.75 percent is hereby annually imposed on the Virginia taxable income

personal_exemption.notes: $930 deduction per personal exemption allowable for federal purposes (dependents included); same brackets for every filing status (not indexed).

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: none; 2026 bills for a 7.75% bracket over $1M (HB 1074) were not enacted

sources.title: Va. Code § 58.1-320. Imposition of tax
sources.quote: Five and three-quarters percent on income in excess of $17,000 for taxable years beginning on and after January 1, 1990.

sources.title: Virginia Tax, New Virginia tax laws (2026 session)
sources.quote: The standard deduction remains at $8,750 for single filers and $17,500 for married couples filing jointly for Tax Year 2026.

sources.title: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03. Deductions
sources.quote: A deduction in the amount of $ 930 for each personal exemption allowable to the taxpayer for federal income tax purposes.

estimated_tax.required_if: expected Virginia tax after withholding and credits is more than $1,000 (new for 2026; was $150)
estimated_tax.notes: First installment is May 1, not April 15. Not required if VAGI under $11,950 single / $23,900 MFJ.

unemployment_2026.notes: Both are statutory (Va. Code §§ 60.2-229 and 60.2-526); VEC may add pool-cost / fund-building charges and an admin fee on top. VEC site blocked automated reading.

local_taxes.name: BPOL business license tax on gross receipts
local_taxes.applies: maximum rate for financial, real estate and professional services ($0.58 per $100 of gross receipts); $0.36 per $100 max for personal/business services, $0.20 retail, $0.16 contracting; each locality sets its own rate (some localities grandfathered higher)
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: no license tax on gross receipts under $100,000 in localities over 50,000 people, or under $50,000 in localities of 25,000-50,000 (a flat license fee may still apply)
local_taxes.quote: For financial, real estate and professional services, fifty-eight cents per $100 of gross receipts

notable: Estimated tax threshold rose to $1,000 for 2026, and the first payment is due May 1 (https://www.tax.virginia.gov/sites/default/files/taxforms/individual-income-tax/2026/760es-2026.pdf)
Standard deduction stays $8,750/$17,500 in 2026, rises to $9,200/$18,400 in 2027 (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title58.1/chapter3/section58.1-322.03/)
LLCs owe no state franchise tax, only a $50 annual registration fee (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title13.1/chapter12/section13.1-1062/)
Local BPOL gross-receipts license tax applies to freelancers above $100,000 receipts in larger localities (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title58.1/chapter37/section58.1-3706/)
Elective PTET at 5.75% remains available for 2026 (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title58.1/chapter3/section58.1-390.3/)
uncertain: Late penalty for the LLC annual registration fee not verified.
VEC 2026 add-on charges (pool cost, fund building, admin fee) not verified; vec.virginia.gov returned 403.
Online filing fee assumed equal to the statutory $100 (SCC fee page not read).
